environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; storytelling focus; quadrant tiled composition; vibrant but grounded colors; 'toy-like' but biologically plausible behaviors.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A cluster of leathery, cream-colored eggs in a soft earth burrow, with one hatchling snake peeking out; Top-Right (Dining): The snake lunging from shadows to catch a small, scurrying lepidosaur (lizard); Bottom-Left (Sleeping): The snake coiled tightly into a perfect circle inside a cool, dark mudstone crevice; Bottom-Right (Playing/Exploration): The snake curiously exploring a pile of small, colorful geodes, its body weaving between the stones.
visual_logic.ground: Moist, dark red floodplain soil with visible sedimentary layering in the burrow shots.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, bright diffused light to ensure all four behavior vignettes are clearly visible and approachable for children.
